About this calendar & sources

A small, independent guide to free conservatory livestreams. Only events with an explicit broadcast label or a working stream link are included. Coverage is selective; more concerts may be available on each school’s website.

    Scheduled refresh: Mondays around 3 a.m. Eastern. Programs, stream links, and performance times can change. “Scheduled now” follows the published timetable; it does not detect whether a video is live.

    Calendar downloads are saved copies, not subscriptions. Where an end time is unavailable, the calendar reserves 90 minutes and labels that estimate.

    Classical LiveGood music. Open to everyone.
